name: prompt-polish
description: Personal fork of oh-my-fable 2.2.0 (Junhan2, MIT). Same always-on working rules and skills, plus a model-specific layer: the hook detects the session model (SessionStart model field, PostModelSwitch) and adds the matching rules from Anthropic's Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5, Opus 5, or Sonnet 5 prompting guide. Skills are named guide-* (guide-rewrite, guide-audit, guide-setup, guide-status); guide-rewrite also follows OpenAI's GPT-6 and Codex guides when run in Codex.
